content: Itim a baar a isal abe

Apan Yɛsu kàsɛmà muyääm a ba unsà nsim naa: « Mbuur mwɛy kàkön ywaŋ a vin. Nde kàdiŋà la a làpaŋ. Nde kàtöŋ ikal mukaam mbɛŋ anà ndwà a ikyɛɛŋ. Ungö apan nde kàpɛ la akà baar musyääl a la, waa kàkyen.
Utaaŋ mubwo, nde kàtöm un'syääl ande mwɛy akà baar bàfàkyer vin ntɔn muwal akà ba kab a isaa lànde.
Baar abà bàtɛ un'syääl awà mpi, bun'düb, waa bun'fuur an'kɔɔ ipɔl.
Nde kàfatööm un'syääl asin. Awà sye, ba bun'düb kun'tswe, waa bun'tö.
Nde kàtöm wàsin, wawun sye ba bàkyer un'dwà, anà bàsin sye mbɔɔn: bumwɛy bàkyer adüb, bumwɛy bàkyer adwa.
Nde kàsàsal awà nà mwan ande mwɛy mpɛl wà nkween. Nde kun'töm ungöngö, waa kàtɛn naa: "Ba bàyàkàkömà mwan amɛ."
Wɛɛ baar bàfàkyer vin bàtɛn ba a ba naa: "Le ikyee ande. Làyi bi kun'dwä, waa ywaŋ làyàkal làbi!"
Apan, ba bun'tɛ mpi, bun'dwä, waa bun'tɔɔm unsà a ywaŋ a vin. »
« Apan ŋàywaŋ asàkyer aben? Nde akyer asàyà, akyɛr asàswaŋ baar mukadwa, waa usàpà ywaŋ akà baar asin.
Nkye bɛ làtäŋ anki itiir a ndaa ki uboo a Ndaa Aŋàsɔn:

content.text: ya yà ndaa ubem u mii a bi!" »

content: Ba bàleŋà ipöl mukun'kɔr, wɛɛ ba bàtiinà un'seŋ bɔɔmà. Ba bàkyer ayɔ̈b naa nde nsim ayi kàtɛ ntɔn ba. Apan ba bàsun'wɛy, waa bàkyen.
Itɛr bàfür akà Sɛzar
Ungö apan, ba bun'tööm Amfarisi amwɛy anà baar a Ɛlɔdi ntɔn ba bun'lwɛb ndaa u mbwo a ntɛɛn ande ŋakwo.

Ba bàyàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, bi ikyàyöb naa ngye awà swalaa anà ngye afàlab anki ukwen a mbuur mwɛy: ngye afàler anki ntabwey a baar, wɛɛ ngye afàlɔŋ mbwo a Nzam unsà ndandaa. Nkye bàkyàpà mbwo, lɛɛ tɛy, mufur itɛr akà Sɛzar? Nkye bi ikyer afur lɛɛ ifur anki? »
Wɛɛ nde, abà kàyöb nde mpem yweel aba, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Ntɔn nkye làman'lwab bɛ? Lan'twääl itɛr a ngim, mɛ in'kwen muman kya. »
Ba bun'twääl imwɛy. Yɛsu waa kafuul naa: « Ntabwey anà ikɔb ki udu akya byà nà? » Ba bàfuur naa: « Byà Sɛzar. »
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làpɛ indiir a Sɛzar akà Sɛzar, indiir a Nzam akà Nzam. » Ba bàkyer abemà ntɔn nde.
Ngwiiyà a akü
Asadusu amwɛy ban'yà akà Yɛsu. Baar abà bàfàtɛn naa akü bàfàwiyà anki. Ba bun'fuulà abà:
« Un'lɔɔŋ, Mɔsɛ kàsɔn abà ntɔn bi: "Isàkal naa baal mwɛy un'tɔŋ ande kan'kwà, kan'sàwɛy un'kaar, ukɔɔn awɛy baan, wɛy nde ubääl un'kweel un'dim awà ntɔn mupà un'tɔŋ ande mbɛŋ."
Bàkäl anà atɔŋ nsambwaar. Wàtàtwɛb kàkyer abääl, waa kàkü ukɔɔn asàwɛy mwan.
Wàyweel kàbääl un'kaar awun, waa kàkü ukɔɔn asàwɛy mwan. Wàtär sye abun,
ba bànsambwaar bàsàwɛy anki akà mwan mwɛy. Ungö a ba bànswà, un'kaar sye waa kàkü.
U ngwiiyà, mpal bàsàwiyà akü, nde asàkal un'kyay a nà uboo a ba? Ntɔn ba bànsambwaar bàkyer un'bääl! »
Yɛsu kakyään naa: « Ntɔn bɛ làyöb anki Ndaa Aŋàsɔn, itàkal ngwal a Nzam, waa bɛ lan'diimà mbwo, kabwɛy anki?
Abun, mpal bàsàwiyà baar uboo a akü, ba bàsàbääl anki akyay, itàkal adim, wɛɛ ba bàsàkal asànaa akyeey u du.
Ntɔn ngwiiyà a akü, nkye bɛ làtäŋ anki, uboo a un'kaan a Mɔsɛ, unsà nsim a ibwiy a mbaa, ndaa kàtɛn Nzam a nde naa: "Mɛ in'wà Nzam a Abàlam, Nzam a Izak anà Nzam a Yakɔb."
Nde kà wà Nzam a akü anki, wɛɛ wà baar a mɔ̈ɔ̈. Bɛ làkadiimà mbwo mbɔɔn. »
Un'kɔɔn kan'söön ndöŋ
Un'lɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn mwɛy awà kàwem nsyeel a mbaaŋ aba, kàkyer ayöb naa Yɛsu kafuur ubwaŋ, laa kàsin nde, waa kun'fuul naa: « Un'kɔɔn nà wàtàtwɛb unsà in'kɔɔn myanswà? »
Yɛsu kàfuur naa: « Wàtàtwɛb awà: "Isàlɛl, wem, Mwol Nzam abi, Mwol wà mwɛy,
ngye ayàkwen Mwol Nzam angye unsà mpem angye yanswà, unsà mɔ̈ɔ̈ angye wanswà, unsà an'kyän angye manswà anà unsà ngwal angye yanswà."
Wàyweel awà: "Ngye ayàkwen un'tɔŋ angye asànaa ngye ŋakwo." In'kɔɔn asin myatɛy myasöön ami. »
Un'lɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn kàfàtɛn naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, ngye an'tɛn ndandaa: Nde wà nde mpɛl, wàsin watɛy,
waa, mukun'kwen u mpem ande yanswà, kun'yɛnà ande wanswà, u ngwal ande yanswà, anà mukwen un'tɔŋ ande asànaa nde ŋakwo, yan'söön ibɔɔn byanswà anà an'kab. »
Yɛsu kàmɛn nde naa nde kan'fuur a un'yɛnà, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ngye kwel watɛy anà Imwol a Nzam. » Ungö apan, akà mbuur mwɛy kàfun'sà anki mfuul.
Klistɔ anà David
Apan, Yɛsu kàlɔɔŋà u ndwà a Nzam, waa kàtɛɛnà naa: « Ya ye aben naa alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn ban'kwo mutɛn naa Klistɔ wà mwan a David?
David ŋakwo kàtɛn u ngwal a Dwɛɛl In'kyɛɛl naa:

content.text: Bwaay u kɔɔ amɛ là ibaal,
tii mpal in'sàsà mɛ ayiiŋ angye u ngyɛl in'kɔl angye."
David ŋakwo kun'bel Mwol, apan nde mwan ande wà aben? »

content: Un'sɛŋ a baar mbɔɔn kun'weemà unsà un'sak.
Yɛsu wàmuswaŋ baar mukal kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn.
Unsà an'lɔɔŋ ande, nde kàtɛɛnà naa: « Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn: ba bàfàkwen muyilyaaŋ anà mvwɛl, naa bapɛ mbɔr kà ikal a nköŋ,
bàfàsɔɔl an'kir amà kusà uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà anà ikal atàtwɛb kà in'kyɔm.
Ba bàfàduum indiir a akweel adim, taaŋ nsil alan ba bàfasà ngyamàkà a bwɛlàbwɛl. Nsaŋ aba isàkal yà kölàköl! »
An'kab kàpɛ un'kweel a un'dim wàŋàlàmbwà
Apan Yɛsu kàbwaay kusà a insak a an'kab, waa kàlerà naa baar bàkàsaa aben ngim uboo a kya. Aŋin'naaŋ bàmbɔɔn bàsye mbɔɔn.
Un'kweel a un'dim wàŋàlàmbwà waa kàyi, waa kàsi bitɛr a ngim ibyeel, byàsànten.
Yɛsu kàbel alɔŋki ande, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, un'kweel a un'dim wàŋàlàmbwà wà kàn'sà yàŋàsöön baar banswà bàsaa uboo a insak.
Ntɔn baar banswà ban'pà ngim ikɔ̈ɔ̈n ndöŋ akà ba. Wɛɛ nde, nde kan'wal unsà làmbwà ande ntɔn mupà yinà yanswà kàkäl nde ayà ntɔn mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande. »
